title: MV Cannot set properties of null (setting 'opacity')

I usually play these games with Joiplay. Thanks for the help

Well, reading properties of null always means the game is looking for something that isn't there. Means there's nothing you can do as a player to fix it. As shadow dragon mentioned, this can have a plethora of reasons.
As the crash message also says, report the bug to the developer.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
To be more specific, opacity is an attribute that only exists on pictures, either background, sprite or something like that.
and the error says "I cannot set the opacity because the specified picture does not exist (is NULL).
Whether that is a timing error (picture already deleted) or a reference error (picture never existed) or an access error (failed to load) cannot be determined from the available info, but all those cases point to either the developer or the hoster of the game
